pages.text: The $(d)Anti-Field Block$() allows you to $(9)temporarily disable certain Genes$().$(br2)Specifically, it disables the $(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/item_attraction_field)Item Attraction Field$(/l) and $(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/xp_attraction_field)XP Attraction Field$(/l) when enabled.$(br2)The $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/anti_field_orb)Anti-Field Orb$(/l) functions similarly, but in item form.
The Anti-Field Block is active by default, and can be disabled with a Redstone signal.$(br2)While active, it disables affected Genes within a 25-block radius by default. This radius is configurable.
